source_audit_findings: Source explicitly warns its technical.indicators.supertrend implementation is unvalidated; independent indicator parity test required before scoring.
Freqtrade strategy is long-only (enter_long/exit_long), not short-enabled; do not fabricate short side.
Buy/sell params differ from IntParameter declared defaults; explicitly apply source buy_params and sell_params, not defaults.
populate_indicators loops across parameter ranges, potentially expensive; only fixed chosen combinations should be computed in an independent replay, with parity test.
ROI, stop and trailing are percent-based and portable to BTC/ETH; must reproduce Freqtrade ROI/trailing order and next-bar causality with 1m stop-first fills.
199 1H startup candles must precede evaluated period; authentic 2024 history is needed for full January 2025 IST month.
Not yet executed on either market; no profit factor, return or alert may be inferred.
experiments.next_step: Build a fixed-parameter causal 1H indicator replay and 1m exit execution with verified technical.indicators Supertrend parity; backtest BOTH assets and reconcile monthly account equity including funding, January coverage and MTM.

experiments.source_claims: BTC 209 trades, 42.1% win rate, PF 1.46, CAGR 7.4%; author-reported only, NOT independently verified
experiments.strategy: 1H close > previous daily high +1.5% (short below low -1.5%), all three EMA50 1H/4H/1D aligned, ADX14 >=25, volume >=1.2x 20H volume, ATR14 3.5x initial stop, breakeven at +2ATR, 2ATR trailing, 1% equity initial stop risk
audit_findings: 4H and daily EMA50 are calculated using full period close via resample.last() then reindex/ffill at period start; this can leak future 4H/day close into earlier hourly signals.

Next-hour bar close is used to update trailing stop before next-hour low/high is checked, potentially retroactively filling a stop that did not exist at the time; same-bar high triggers breakeven before low is checked, path ambiguous.
ADX/volume filter is applied with continue even while in an open position; exit monitoring and equity_curve updates skip filtered bars.
Trades and equity curve ignore taker fees, GST, slippage, funding, spread, liquidation and unrealized MTM.
Quantity is sized by stop distance without cap on actual leverage or notional.
CAGR uses hardcoded starting capital 10000 and original author's BTC-only data; not evidence of Delta BTCUSD or ETHUSD 22-month performance.
required_corrections: Build completed 1H/4H/1D resampling with no lookahead and next-hour execution; explicitly validate signal timestamps.
Check 1m stop-first OHLC sequence and update trailing only after eligible observed data; monitor open positions regardless of entry filters.
Apply same fixed percentage/ATR rules to BTCUSD and ETHUSD with realistic capped exposure and Delta costs, monthly IST MTM accounting.
Verify missing Dec 2024 18:30-23:59 UTC January warmup and actual funding before treating results as verified.
experiments.verdict: RESEARCH LEAD ONLY; source backtest performance not credible until lookahead/stop logic repaired; no paired test or monthly results this iteration
experiments.next_action: Only replay a clearly documented corrected causal variant after source parity and full data validation; otherwise seek a cleaner pinned external strategy.
